stage_definition.parent: 3 fixed parent ranks per seed, equally weighted
stage_definition.raw: 30 proposal slots per seed across 5 arms and 3 parents, failure fallback retained
stage_definition.S3: 15 fixed candidate pools per seed, sealed winner or retained parent

probe_definition: Stored H probes only: 40 measured rounds and 20 random streams; controlled histories have 7 externally supplied CC rounds; recovery averages the TFT/GTFT/ALLC probes, capped at probe-specific remaining horizon.
limits: Stage joins are within-pool comparisons, not evolutionary trajectories.
Two configurations differ in more than thinking; comparisons are not a pure thinking treatment effect.
Raw minus parent is not the causal effect of matched diagnosis.
Examples are descriptive, selected after outcomes were known; category prevalence is not inferred from examples.

non_thinking.validation: All raw behaviour and raw/S3 payoff seed means match released results.

thinking.validation: All raw behaviour and raw/S3 payoff seed means match released results.

examples.selection_rule: Among valid candidates with successful H default and behaviour measurements, all five information arms pooled, satisfying the named category, nearest category-median H payoff change; deterministic config/id tie-break. Categories and rule are post-hoc.
examples.code_summary_zh: 父代在历史长至少10轮且对手最近连续两次D时，以0.5概率D；候选新增基于累计D占优或低合作率的分支，进入该分支后仅以0.06概率C。在持续背叛探针中单方面合作由0.49降至0.06，同时三个恢复探针的平均截尾恢复时间增加3.1833轮。这描述同一真实修改的防御与恢复变化，不把其中某段代码认定为已经通过消融验证的原因。

examples.selection_rule: Among valid candidates with successful H default and behaviour measurements, all five information arms pooled, satisfying the named category, nearest category-median H payoff change; deterministic config/id tie-break. Categories and rule are post-hoc.
examples.code_summary_zh: 父代含最近8轮至少一半为D的历史窗口分支；候选压缩为若对手上一轮C则C（第100轮除外），并在连续D长度为1且累计D不超过2、或连续D长度为3且累计D不超过4时输出C，否则D。候选在GTFT恢复探针的末五轮相互合作由0.16升至0.75，但TFT探针由0.05降至0，三个恢复探针的平均截尾时间减少1.75轮。因此该例只说明平均恢复改善，不表示所有恢复情境均改善，也不建立准确匹配反馈的因果效应。

examples.selection_rule: Among valid candidates with successful H default and behaviour measurements, all five information arms pooled, satisfying the named category, nearest category-median H payoff change; deterministic config/id tie-break. Categories and rule are post-hoc.
examples.code_summary_zh: 父代在双方累计D均超过20时按轮次奇偶交替C/D；候选在对手累计D超过历史的一半时直接D，并对特定交替报复序列提供C响应。候选还会在最近10轮对手无D时根据此前对方对自身D的响应决定随机D概率。局部探针中持续背叛暴露降至0、平均恢复时间减少12.95轮，H收益却下降0.03233；这说明这些局部探针并不构成完整的收益充分统计量。该候选V为2.13744，高于父代2.13213，已经通过门控；未采用是因为同池另一候选V为2.17933，而非门控拒绝。
